description: This file defines an internal interface IMembershipGossiper within the Orleans.Runtime.MembershipService namespace. The interface declares a method for gossiping membership information to remote silos.

classes.name: IMembershipGossiper
classes.description: Internal interface for membership gossiping in Orleans runtime. It provides a method to propagate membership snapshots to specified remote silos.

methods.name: GossipToRemoteSilos
methods.description: Asynchronously gossips membership information to a list of remote silos, sending the current snapshot and details of the updated silo and its status.
